settings.title: Hearth Infrared Sauna Panel
settings.content: Transform Your Space into a Sanctuary

settings.title: Your Hearth is always in the right place.
settings.content: This versatile incandescent infrared therapy panel brings the warmth of a hearth into the modern age, offering you a personal indoor bonfire (minus the toxic particulates) or a space-saving sauna experience.

settings.title: Supportive Heat for Daily Rituals
settings.content: The Hearth adds steady, radiant heat and full-spectrum infrared to your practice—perfect for yoga, meditation, or breathwork. It grounds you in warmth while supporting deeper relaxation and detox.

settings.title: A Retreat in Your Living Room
settings.content: No special room required. Just plug in the Hearth and instantly transform your space into a sanctuary of warmth, light, and calm.

settings.title: Turn Your Shower into an Infrared Sauna
settings.content: The Hearth makes it easy to convert your shower to a sauna; no remodel, no hassle. Pair it with our Shower Upgrade to transform any enclosed shower space into a red light infrared sauna sanctuary.

settings.title: Upgrade Your Cabinet Sauna
settings.content: The Hearth supercharges your cabinet sauna with penetrating radiant heat and full-spectrum light therapy—delivering deeper detox, better sweat, and more revitalizing results in every session.

settings.title: Build a SuperSauna
settings.content: Ready to turn things up? Add a Hearth Trio to your Classic FireLight® Sauna to create a higher-heat, higher-intensity sauna experience that works faster and goes deeper.

settings.title: Closet-Sized Healing Oasis
settings.content: Small space? Big impact. Add the Hearth to any compact setup—like a closet or corner nook—for a powerful, private sanctuary that fits your life.

settings.title: Proprietary FireLight® Bulb
settings.content:
At the core of every SaunaSpace experience is the FireLight® Bulb—our signature innovation, shaped by over a decade of R&D. Hand-blown from pure quartz-stained glass, it delivers a finely tuned incandescent spectrum that peaks in red and near-infrared for maximum light therapy, while extending into mid- and far-infrared for deeply effective heat.

This full-spectrum design captures the most healing wavelengths of the sun—without the harmful ones—activating cellular repair, detoxification, and full-body rejuvenation. Built for longevity and performance, each bulb offers thousands of hours of radiant therapy and comes backed by a five-year warranty. This isn’t just a bulb. It’s the light that transforms.
settings.content_mobile:
Our signature innovation, the FireLight® Bulb is the result of over a decade of R&D. Hand-blown from pure quartz-stained glass, it emits a full-spectrum glow calibrated for optimal red and near-infrared light. 

This biologically aligned spectrum supports deep heat, cellular repair, and rejuvenation—thousands of radiant hours, zero harmful wavelengths.

settings.title: EMF-Shielded Design
settings.content:
Unlike most infrared saunas and red light devices—which often expose users to high levels of EMFs—the Hearth Panel is fully shielded and grounded at every connection point. Electromagnetic fields have been shown to disrupt cellular signaling and increase oxidative stress. 

By eliminating this hidden interference, the Hearth Panel supports a deeper, more complete healing response—calming your nervous system while amplifying the power of FireLight®.

EMFs can disrupt cellular signaling and increase oxidative stress. By eliminating this interference, the Hearth™ supports deeper healing, calming your nervous system and amplifying the power of FireLight®.

settings.title: Adjustable Intensity Levels
settings.content:
With three manual switches, the Hearth Panel lets you choose from low, medium, or high intensity—so you can tailor each session to your needs. 

Ideal for first-time users, the highly sensitive, or anyone seeking a gentler start, this customizable control ensures you get the most out of FireLight® at your own pace.

settings.title: Trio and Quartet Options
settings.content:
Choose the Trio for smaller spaces, cozy corners, or targeted sessions, or go with the Quartet for full-body immersion. Whether you build a complete sauna or use FireLight® throughout your home, both options deliver spectrum-tuned light and deeply restorative heat to support healing and rejuvenation. 

Especially comforting during colder months, and ideal for daily rituals, moments of self-care, and deep, body-centered restoration.
settings.content_mobile:
Choose the Trio for smaller spaces or targeted use, or the Quartet for full-body immersion. Both deliver spectrum-tuned light and restorative heat to support healing. 

Ideal for daily rituals, self-care, and deep replenishment—especially in colder months or anytime your body craves warmth, grounding, and renewal.

settings.title: Sustainable Basswood
settings.content:
Sourced from responsibly managed American forests, basswood is a lightweight hardwood with a creamy tone, fine grain, and subtle, honeyed scent. Long used in herbal traditions for its calming properties, it brings a sense of warmth and quiet beauty to your space. 

Each piece is hand-shaped and sanded to a velvety finish by skilled makers, then left completely untreated—free of stains, sealers, or synthetics—to preserve the purity of the wood and the integrity of your sanctuary. A time-honored material, reborn for modern healing.

settings.title: Non-Toxic Stainless Steel
settings.content: All hardware is made from uncoated, medical-grade stainless steel—free from aluminum, paints, plastics, and synthetic coatings. We use no glues, no composites, and no hidden materials. Just clean, hypoallergenic strength that won’t off-gas or break down over time. Built for purity. Designed to last.

settings.title: SuperSauna (Optional Upgrade)
settings.content:
Transform your Hearth Quartet into a SuperSauna by adding a three-bulb Hearth™ Trio. This powerful configuration surrounds you with amplified light and heat—doubling the intensity to deliver the same benefits in half the time.

The experience is immersive and deeply satisfying, with a radiant warmth that feels as good as it is effective. More heat, more light, more of what your body craves.

settings.content: At the Hearth of the matter, this product harnesses the power of the FireLight spectrum—a proprietary blend of red light and near, mid, and far infrared light emitted from our meticulously crafted incandescent bulbs. This unique technology is the very foundation of what makes our saunas and targeted therapy lights exceptional.

settings.content: The FireLight® Spectrum blends red and near-infrared light in the body’s most responsive range. It fuels energy, activates detox, and restores balance at the cellular level. This isn’t surface sweat. It’s deep, biological renewal.

settings.question: Is the Hearth Pedestal included?
settings.answer: The Hearth Pedestal isn’t included, but it’s a thoughtfully designed companion piece, especially if you’re using your infrared sauna panel outside a traditional enclosure or converting an existing cabinet sauna. The Pedestal creates stable, centered support and optimizes your exposure to FireLight® therapy. You can easily add one on the Hearth Buy Page.

settings.question: Can I add the Hearth to my existing cabinet sauna?
settings.answer:
Yes, it's one of the best ways to upgrade a traditional or far-infrared cabinet sauna into a full-spectrum, near infrared sanctuary.

Recommended configuration: Use the Hearth Pedestal and Sauna Stool to position your Hearth at core level. Remove your built-in bench if needed, and sit comfortably on the stool to receive direct, targeted light.

Bench method:  Place your Hearth on your sauna’s built-in bench. Just make sure the height and angle allow for full-body coverage.

Wall-mount option:  Use the built-in handle to hang the Hearth on a wall. Be sure to anchor securely with hardware rated for at least 25 lbs.

Need more support? We’ve created a detailed guide on cabinet sauna conversions.

settings.question: Can the Hearth be used outside a sauna enclosure—and why would I want to?
settings.answer:
Yes, beautifully so. Many of our customers use the Hearth as a red light therapy panel outside a sauna for everyday wellness: while journaling, meditating, stretching, or simply resting.

You can also use it in the morning or evening as a gentle ambient light to support circadian rhythms, no flicker, no LED glare, just a warm glow that’s deeply regulating to your system.

It’s incredibly helpful for skin rejuvenation, mood balance, circadian support, and blue light mitigation, especially during screen-heavy days. The FireLight® bulbs emit a comforting, flicker-free glow, no LED glare, no harsh edges, just pure light and gentle warmth.

Without enclosure, you won’t generate a deep detox sweat (raising core body temperature requires a sauna enclosure).

Still: for non-sweat days, travel, or stacked wellness rituals, the Hearth delivers a lot, beautifully.

settings.question: How do I mount or position the Hearth for best results?
settings.answer:
The Hearth is designed to be simple and versatile, no tools, no fuss.

The Hearth Pedestal is the most stable and user-friendly setup. Just place the Hearth on the Pedestal (not a bench, it’s not meant to be sat on), center it for balance, and you’re good to go. It stands freely without needing to lean on anything.

You can also use the built-in carrying handle to hang the Hearth on a wall. If you go that route, make sure to use anchors or hardware rated to hold at least 25 pounds.

Wherever you place it, the goal is the same: direct, radiant light right where your body needs it.

settings.question: How much electricity does the Hearth use?
settings.answer:
Surprisingly little, especially considering what it does for your energy, skin, and cellular health.

  • 750 watts → around 12¢ per hour
  • 1000 watts → about 16¢ per hour

That’s less than a cycle on your dishwasher, and way more rejuvenating.

settings.question: What’s the difference between the Hearth Trio and the Hearth Quartet?
settings.answer:
The Hearth Trio has 3 FireLight® Bulbs and is ideal for smaller spaces, shorter sessions, or stacking with other wellness tools. The Hearth Quartet has 4 bulbs and offers stronger irradiance, deeper heat, and faster therapeutic results.

If you’re using it as your primary sauna light or want more intensity, go with the Quartet. If you want something more compact or ambient, the Trio is a great fit.

settings.question: Can I switch between the Trio and the Quartet later?
settings.answer: Not directly. The number of bulbs is part of the Hearth’s internal design, so if you buy the Trio, it will always have 3 bulbs. If you’re unsure, go with the Quartet, you can always use fewer bulbs during a session, but you can’t add one later.

settings.question: How close should I sit to the Hearth?
settings.answer:
Most people sit 18 to 30 inches away. That sweet spot delivers deep warmth without overwhelming heat.

If you’re looking for gentle stimulation, start farther back. Want stronger activation? Move closer. The goal is to feel relaxed, open, and warmly held.

settings.question: Do I rotate like I do in the sauna?
settings.answer:
You can, but you don’t have to.

If you’re using the Hearth for full-body therapy, gentle rotation helps ensure even exposure. But for targeted sessions, like on your chest, face, or back, just stay still and soak it in. Let the light do the work.

settings.question: Can I use the Hearth every day?
settings.answer: Yes—many people use it daily, even multiple times a day. Sessions can be as short as 5–15 minutes depending on your distance and intention. Whether it’s part of your morning ritual, post-work recovery, or before bed, the Hearth is built for daily use.

settings.question: How hot does the Hearth get?
settings.answer: It gets warm, intentionally. The Hearth delivers both near infrared light and gentle radiant heat, just like the FireLight® Sauna. It shouldn’t feel harsh or overwhelming, but if it ever feels too intense, increase your distance or shorten your session.

settings.question: Can I take the Hearth with me when traveling?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Though more substantial than the Glow, the Hearth was made to move with you. With a built-in handle and a lightweight design, just 7 lbs for the Trio and 11.5 lbs for the Quartet, it’s easy to tuck into the backseat for road trips, retreats, or extended stays. Just allow it to cool completely before packing, and remove the bulbs for safe transport. Whether you’re setting up in a hotel, a rental, or a quiet corner of your getaway, the Hearth brings full-spectrum healing wherever you roam.

settings.question: Can I lie down and use the Hearth?
settings.answer: Yes, as long as it’s stable, safe, and aimed correctly. Some people lie down with the Hearth on a chair or table nearby, especially during meditation, yoga, or breathwork. Just don’t place it on a soft surface where it could overheat or tip.

settings.question: How long do the FireLight® Bulbs last, and how do I get replacements?
settings.answer:
The FireLight® Bulb is rated for 5,000 hours and typically lasts 5 to 10 years, depending on use. When it eventually burns out, replacing it is simple, it screws in just like a standard bulb, no tools needed.

If it burns out within five years, we’ll replace it for free under our warranty. After that, you’ll still get a special replacement price of $95.

Long-lasting, easy to replace, and always backed by us.
